description: §6.7.7 `<#id>.refetch()` as the LATER statement of an inline multi-statement handler re-executes the fetch (RUNTIME, sqlEngine:"real"). Mount-only request (deps=[]); `onclick=${ @userId = 2; <#userReq>.refetch() }`. After the click @userData is user 2 ("b"). Pre-S444 the handler's statement parse did not lower `<#userReq>`, so the refetch became an html-fragment and emitted nothing (only the write survived).
rationale: §6.7.7 Properties: "`<#id>.refetch()` | `() -> void` | Imperatively re-execute the fetch body"; EC-7 write-then-refetch. g-request-refetch-statement-dropped (S444).
